title: Customer integration roundup - weekly sync (2026-03-11)
content:
Meeting: Solutions Eng + Professional Services weekly sync
Date: 2026-03-11 10:00 PST (45m)
Facilitator: Leah Park
Attendees: Leah, Marcus, Priya, Tomás, Ruth, Samir, (and QA: Elena - joined for customer demo notes)

TL;DR:
- Mostly steady: 3 active integrations with medium risk, 2 low-risk pilots.
- Top blockers: HSM/KMS keywrap delays for AcmeHealth, embedding quality regression seen with FinNova after model swap, EU latency spikes for RetailCo after autoscaler tuning.
- Action-heavy week: infra PR for autoscaler (PLATFORM-788), Proserv ticket to escalate HSM vendor (PROSERV-412), run expanded load test for EU region (next Tue).

Notes / Discussion (raw):
1) AcmeHealth (healthcare) — Dedicated + Private pilot
   - Status: In private deployment UAT. Basic inference functionality done.
   - Current ask: HSM integration for customer-managed keys is required for go-live (PHI). HSM vendor (BlueKey) is slow on endpoint certs.
   - Blocker: HSM cert provisioning + network egress policy check (VPC peering).
   - Impact: blocks final hardening checklist and compliance sign-off.
   - Action items:
     * Priya: escalate with vendor contact (email sent, waiting response) — target: 2026-03-13.
     * Tomás: prepare fallback plan to use Redwood-managed KMS for short window — document tradeoffs (privacy note) — due 2026-03-14.
     * Linked ticket: JIRA PROSERV-412 (HSM certs)
   - Notes to self: ask security to pre-approve key-rotation policy doc so we don't wait on legal later.

2) FinNova (fintech) — Hosted API, embeddings and ranking
   - Status: embedding-based search pilot; customer reports more false positives after we flipped to quantized variant (v-q2).
   - Observations: similarity scores drift by ~0.12 on sample set vs baseline; model outputs more generic matches.
   - Hypothesis: quantization-induced semantic degradation + different tokenization trimming for long queries.
   - Action items:
     * Marcus: run comparative eval across full eval set (2000 prompts) and provide delta table — due 2026-03-13.
     * QA (Elena): prepare 30 exemplar prompts for on-call demo and manual inspection — due 2026-03-12.
     * Product: consider temporary rollback to float variant for production traffic with throttled QPS — Leah to coordinate with platform.
   - Interim mitigation: route 10% of traffic to v-float using canary policy; need routing rule config (Console -> Rollouts).
   - Linked: CONFLUENCE:Embedding-eval-results, JIRA PLATFORM-788 (canary routing change).

3) RetailCo (ecommerce) — Dedicated GPU pool in eu-west-1
   - Status: Acceptance tests mostly green; intermittent latency spikes during peak regional batch jobs.
   - Root cause suspects: autoscaler cooldown too long + batching policy causing bursty queues.
   - Action items:
     * Ruth: raise infra PR to tweak cooldown and add more aggressive pre-warming hooks — PR redwood/infra#456 — review by 2026-03-12.
     * Samir: instrument additional tracing (token-level latency histograms) and add dashboard panel for EU 95/99 latency — due 2026-03-15.
   - Temporary: increase dedicated headroom by +1 worker pool for next 72 hours (ops approved) — monitor.

4) EduLabs (edtech) — Pilot finished, moving to procurement
   - Status: Pilot success metrics met (latency, cost per query), docs handed to CS.
   - Next: finalize SOW and send invoice. Small integration follow-ups on custom prompt templates.
   - Action: Leah to coordinate SOW sign-off and billing contact (procurement).

5) Small customers / misc
   - Two sandbox trials ended; one customer asked about on-prem package pricing. Priya to send standard private-deploy SKU doc.
   - Questions from internal AE about latency SLOs for Dedicated vs Hosted — add to next week's agenda.

Operational items / runway
- Canary rollout schedule: v2.1 runtime optimizations go live 2026-03-18 (gradual ramp). Need final smoke test next Tue.
- Load test: expanded EU regional load test to run 2026-03-16 (Samir to own test harness).
- Capacity: Dedicated capacity forecasts updated — see spreadsheet link (in linked artifacts). We may need to push extra GPUs to retail pilot window (contact infra).

Unresolved questions / risks
- HSM vendor timeline (AcmeHealth) still uncertain; worst-case fallback adds compliance overhead. If > 7 days delay, escalate to Legal/Customer success for contract amendment.
- Embedding regression severity: if delta > 0.1 on average similarity across eval set, we need to roll back quantized variant. Marcus to quantify.
- Autoscaler tuning might mask deeper batching inefficiencies; if spikes persist after PR, schedule deep-dive with runtime team.

Action Items (concrete)
- Priya Shah: escalate HSM vendor, update PROSERV-412 by 2026-03-13.
- Tomás Ortega: draft fallback KMS plan and privacy tradeoffs by 2026-03-14.
- Marcus Liu: full embedding eval + delta table by 2026-03-13.
- Elena (QA): manual embedding sample review & notes by 2026-03-12.
- Ruth Kim: open infra PR for autoscaler adjustments (redwood/infra#456) — assign reviewers by 2026-03-12.
- Samir Patel: EU load test harness + dashboard panels by 2026-03-15.
- Leah Park: coordinate FinNova canary routing and SOW for EduLabs — 2026-03-14.

Misc / quick wins
- Reuse the onboarding checklist v0.9 (Confluence) and add explicit HSM step to reduce future surprise.
- Prep a short FAQ for sales on quantization tradeoffs (1-pager) — useful for AE calls.

Next meeting: 2026-03-18 10:00 PST
If anything urgent pops up, ping #proservices-integration-thread on Slack and add to the shared agenda doc.

— end of notes —

Draft status: informal notes and action list. Will tidy up into a short customer-facing status snapshot if CS asks.
